name: usage-band
description: A band above the prompt showing your 5-hour and 7-day limits, context window and prompt-cache hit rate, styled for the terminal and the desktop app

limitWarn.title: Limit warning at (%)
limitWarn.description: The 5h and 7d limits turn the warning color at this percent used

contextWarn.title: Context warning at (%)
contextWarn.description: The context window turns the warning color at this percent full

cacheWarn.title: Cache hit warning below (%)
cacheWarn.description: The cache hit rate turns the warning color below this percent

colorFiveHour.title: 5h limit color
colorFiveHour.description: Hex color such as #6a9bcc; an invalid value falls back to the default

colorSevenDay.title: 7d limit color
colorSevenDay.description: Hex color such as #4f7aa6; an invalid value falls back to the default

colorContext.title: Context color
colorContext.description: Hex color such as #d97757; an invalid value falls back to the default

colorCache.title: Cache hit color
colorCache.description: Hex color such as #788c5d; an invalid value falls back to the default

colorWarn.title: Warning color
colorWarn.description: Hex color such as #b8433b; an invalid value falls back to the default
